newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cathay to increase ex-Paris cargo rates from Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: Cathay to increase ex-Paris cargo rates from Dec 9.

text.p: Cathay Pacific said it would increase cargo rates on a number of destinations from Paris, effective December 9.
"Ex-Paris rates to Hong Kong, Tapei and Seoul will increase by five percent but rates to Japan and Australia will be unchanged," Cathay's freight sales director, France, Jean-Luc Py, told Reuters.
The last time the Hong Kong-based airline had increased it ex-Paris cargo rates was in October 1995.
Cathay had decided on rate increases in preference to implementing fuel surcharges for "commerical and technical reasons," Py said.

Cathay operates three Boeing 747-200 freighter each week from Charles de Gaulle to Hong Kong as well as a daily 747-400 passenger service. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
